SUPER CRITICAL: The generated React+Tailwind code MUST be converted to match the target project's technology stack and styling system.
1. Analyze the target codebase to identify: technology stack, styling approach, component patterns, and design tokens
2. Convert React syntax to the target framework/library
3. Transform all Tailwind classes to the target styling system while preserving exact visual design
4. Follow the project's existing patterns and conventions
DO NOT install any Tailwind as a dependency unless the user instructs you to do so.
Node ids have been added to the code as data attributes, e.g. `data-node-id="1:2"`.

These styles are contained in the design: Analytify/Section: Font(family: "Outfit", style: SemiBold, size: 20, weight: 600, lineHeight: 28, letterSpacing: 0), Analytify/Label: Font(family: "Outfit", style: SemiBold, size: 14, weight: 600, lineHeight: 20, letterSpacing: 0), Analytify/Heading: Font(family: "Outfit", style: Bold, size: 28, weight: 700, lineHeight: 36, letterSpacing: 0), Analytify/Body: Font(family: "Outfit", style: Regular, size: 16, weight: 400, lineHeight: 24, letterSpacing: 0), Analytify/Caption: Font(family: "Outfit", style: Regular, size: 14, weight: 400, lineHeight: 20, letterSpacing: 0), Analytify/Mobile navigation label: Font(family: "Outfit", style: Bold, size: 11.199999809265137, weight: 700, lineHeight: 16.799999237060547, letterSpacing: 0), Analytify/Mobile floating navigation: Effect(type: DROP_SHADOW, color: #0000006B, offset: (0, 16), radius: 50, spread: 0); Effect(type: BACKGROUND_BLUR, radius: 18).

Component descriptions: The following components have usage descriptions or documentation links defined in Figma. These descriptions provide important context about the intended usage, best practices, and any constraints for each component. Follow these guidelines when implementing or using these components.

## Analytify/Route glows
**Node ID:** 529:21518

Route glows animate between destination layouts independently of the persistent particle loop.

## Analytify/Ambient background
**Node ID:** 266:18224

Large green and blue glows are fixed within a page, including during scrolling. Glow positions change only on page navigation, with a smooth route transition. Particle phases loop continuously over 24 seconds; all phases within one Scene have identical glow positions, size and opacity. Shared backdrop behind opaque cards and navigation. Mobile uses fewer and softer dots. Still variant provides reduced motion. Implementation must preserve one shell-level background: scroll can move dots but must never modify glow coordinates.

## Analytify/Mobile header
**Node ID:** 25:17

Persistent product header; app navigation and explicit tools/account actions. Focus/public routes hide app navigation.

## Analytify/Icon / bars
**Node ID:** 62:2381

PrimeIcons bars from the app icon library.

## Analytify/Page heading
**Node ID:** 139:7724

Shared identity region for every full page. Desktop: Display heading, Body description, 8 px gap. Mobile: Heading title, optional description, 8 px gap. Primary actions may sit beside this component on desktop or in the content toolbar on mobile. Page padding is 32 px desktop / 16 px mobile; the following content starts 16 px / 12 px after the header. Do not add per-page offsets or headings above this component.

## Analytify/Navigation / Back
**Node ID:** 241:14393

Universal previous-page action for deeper pages. Fixed 92 × 44 touch target, directional icon and concise label. Stays at the trailing edge of the shared navigation bar; breadcrumbs keep their alignment.

## Analytify/Preference row
**Node ID:** 35:1089

Named preference with helper text and a switch. 48 px target and explicit disabled reason.

## Analytify/Icon / sync
**Node ID:** 62:2363

PrimeIcons sync from the app icon library.

## Analytify/Switch
**Node ID:** 29:957

Named switch. Clear checked state, 48 px minimum touch region, labelled disabled reason and keyboard focus in implementation.

## Analytify/primary
**Node ID:** 24:85

Shared primary control. 48 px targets. Keyboard focus remains visible. Disabled only while unavailable or submitting; explain the reason nearby.

## Analytify/Icon / save
**Node ID:** 227:11810

Semantic save icon. Pair with an existing accessible control label. Color inherits action role.

## Analytify/Mobile footer
**Node ID:** 120:3944

Spotify attribution and legal access after the mobile scroll document. Uses shared text styles and legal button.

## Analytify/tertiary
**Node ID:** 24:103

Shared tertiary control. 48 px targets. Keyboard focus remains visible. Disabled only while unavailable or submitting; explain the reason nearby.

## Analytify/Icon / shield
**Node ID:** 222:11668

Semantic shield icon paired with an existing link or section name.

## Analytify/Mobile navigation
**Node ID:** 25:29

Mobile shortcut bar: Settings > Navigation selects 0–5 tools. Default Playlists, Stats, History. Hidden entirely with 0 selected, releasing viewport height. Preferences persist across prototype page navigation. Website implementation should persist the choice per user/device. The top Menu button stays available.

## Analytify/Mobile navigation item
**Node ID:** 58:2139

Code-aligned mobile item: 54 px target, centered PrimeIcon and label, 4 px gap, default and selected states.

## Analytify/Icon / list
**Node ID:** 58:2106

PrimeIcons list from the implemented mobile navigation.

## Analytify/Icon / chart-bar
**Node ID:** 58:2114

PrimeIcons chart-bar from the implemented mobile navigation.

## Analytify/Icon / history
**Node ID:** 58:2119

PrimeIcons history from the implemented mobile navigation.
